source_scope: Reused complete archived gate/channel/profile/line catalogue, selective live source review of specified themes. Unlisted carrier rows explicitly have no new directions in this bounded block; prior mappings remain untouched. Definitions and directions are modern operational hypotheses, not quotations or empirical findings.

items.definition: Reported ability to change another person's understanding or action when deliberately adapting persuasive framing; not eloquence, persuasion frequency, or an independently verified success rate.
Regularly chooses persuasive framing to obtain uptake rather than simply informing or explaining, across comparable situations.
Habitually communicates lessons through developed personal-experience stories or narrative rather than only conceptual explanation.

Repeatedly encounters others assigning broad practical problem-solving expectations beyond an explicitly accepted role; measure others' stated expectations and consequences, not the respondent's self-image.
Others recurrently recognize a particular aptitude and seek its use without the person first soliciting that opportunity; not whether the person waits to initiate.
Recurrently influences a group's course through proposals that members accept, distinguished from formal command and mere debating ability.
Regularly repeats a defined skill or pattern to improve its precision or execution after attaining basic competence, distinguished from knowledge acquisition.
Pursuit of refined skill or mastery is a recurring goal in itself, beyond the immediate functional project or problem.
Maintains recurring self-chosen daily or weekly rhythms across ordinary circumstances, not merely ability to schedule.
Recurrent alternating stretches of very intensive activity and substantially reduced activity; no claim that recovery is excessive or bodily authority determines choices.
Unfinished endeavors remain mentally burdensome and motivate closing the cycle even when there is no pressing deadline; distinguish completing useful work from persistence without utility.
Regularly learns what works through attempting, observing failure or feedback, and adapting in practice; distinct from liking novelty, being accident-prone, or general research.
Frequently seeks unfamiliar experiences for their novelty itself, distinct from traveling or experimenting for a concrete purpose.
Recurring desire for advancement in a material or organizational hierarchy, distinct from resources for autonomy and ambitious goals for others.
Winning or outperforming another person is itself a recurrent motivation, distinct from improving competence and enjoying a challenge.
Recurrently accepts substantial difficulty to pursue a personally meaningful aim and distinguishes worthwhile struggles from pointless ones.
Recurrently seeks control over allocation of material resources in a domain, rather than merely using resources effectively.
Recurrently feels driven to correct imperfections even with little concrete consequence; distinct from correcting consequential errors.
In ongoing cooperative relationships weighs reciprocal support and fairness of agreed contributions; not general generosity or a requirement for all help to be repaid.
Recurrently withholds or selects disclosure of past personal experiences according to audience and relationship, distinguished from seeking solitude.
Recurrently notices other people's practical or emotional needs before requests, distinguished from always acting on them or accurately diagnosing hidden motives.
Within similar interpersonal settings, willingness to talk or engage socially varies substantially with mood; not chronic anger, emotional diagnosis, or decision authority.

policy.admission: Actual reported observations only, separate broad and narrow admissions, explicit negatives only, context-dependent unresolved responses null. All source directions are positive: noncarrier is not opposite behavior. Do not treat a report of capacity as verified success rate.
policy.composition: Fixed equal domain weights within source-specific block; cap each signed item once over carrier union. Compare specific-only and equal mean shared/specific archetype; compare both separately blended with old structural HD score. Correlated block sensitivity, not independent evidence or adopted new weights. All old arms retained.
policy.exclusions: No authority, decision strategy or intuition accuracy, no demographic/life-event claims, no new subjective diagnoses or causal assertions. Gate descriptions' conscious-defined scope retained alongside two explicitly experimental alternatives.
